svg.title: go_first building plans
svg.text: Four floor plans in metres, north up, same scale. A four-storey former print works on a corner of two streets in Hapjeong-dong, Mapo-gu, inside hapjeong_gate_zone,
two streets (about 150 m, 2–3 minutes) from Hanbit Mart. Fictional, no real address. No key or script yet: the layout is decided here from the beats.
